base_prompt:
SPRITE for a comedic 2D game, full body, transparent background (real alpha channel), no ground shadow, no glow, no text, no watermark, ONE character, nothing cropped (head to feet fully visible), centered, portrait about 2:3.
Two references are attached. Reference 1 is the muscular Santa (the CHARACTER identity to keep: white hair, big full white beard, black sunglasses, bare muscular chest with visible abs, red pants with white fur cuffs, black boots, NO belt, NO shirt). Reference 2 shows the exact ART STYLE to use: Korean messenger-sticker / emoticon style, very simple chubby rounded character about 2 heads tall, flat colors with at most one soft shade tone, thin uniform outline, almost no detail, no glossy highlights. Redraw the Santa from reference 1 in the style of reference 2: a chubby chibi SANTA with the same identity points (white beard, sunglasses, red pants, boots), whose muscles are drawn as simple rounded cartoon bumps (big round arms, simple pecs and a simple six-pack drawn with a few lines) so he is still clearly a bodybuilder. He wears a funny DISGUISE instead of the red Santa hat (NO red Santa hat). Hands are empty.
